repair.title: Cancer Death Rates Fell
repair.summary: The American Cancer Society reports that the U.S. cancer death rate fell by 34 percent from 1991 to 2022.
repair.why_it_matters: Less smoking, earlier detection, and better treatment turned many diagnoses into longer lives.
repair.caveat: This is U.S.-specific, and cancer incidence is rising for some groups and cancer types.
